verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that the patents rail runs through a "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" entry and that trademark filing sits under an Online services block. Nothing in the pack shows CIPO publishing, before the user starts, the specific account, credential, or identity-proofing steps required to file. A login link merely signals that an account exists; it is an adjacent signal, not the up-front disclosure the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
